name: Vix
summary: A keyboard-friendly terminal text editor (a "Simple Terminal Rust IDE") built on ratatui: a thin App shell over 102 focused vix-* member crates in a Cargo workspace (edition 2024).
description: Development is specification-driven: each crate owns a spec at crates/<crate>/spec/index.md; cross-cutting and app-level specs live under spec/. When behavior and spec disagree, decide which is correct and make them match. AGENTS.md is the canonical entry point for both human and AI contributors.
